data.mainEntity_0_name: What are the most stylish and currently trending shoes online?
data.mainEntity_0_acceptedAnswer_text: For every occasion, stylish designer shoes work as a fashion statement. data.mainEntity_1_name: What are some tips to buy a shoe online?
data.mainEntity_1_acceptedAnswer_text: Take a good look through the online shoe stores’ collections for options and check their size chart. Consider checking specifications on the sole, heel, material, fastening type and other aspects before buying expensive shoes.
data.mainEntity_2_name: Where can I shop for the best shoes online?
data.mainEntity_2_acceptedAnswer_text: Metro’s online shoe stores offer thousands of designs and styles of shoes for various occasions, be it casual wear, parties and festivals, sports, or formal workwear to fulfil your fashion needs.
data.mainEntity_3_acceptedAnswer_text: Place your foot on an A4 paper and vertically hold your pen to make a dot at the end of your heel and longest toe, then trace the outline of your foot. Measure the distance between both points with a ruler to note the centimetres. Do the same for your other foot and check out the brand’s size chart to find your perfect size.
data.mainEntity_4_name: Can all types of shoes be washed?
data.mainEntity_4_acceptedAnswer_text: Rubber and silicon material shoes can be washed while some others cannot be washed. However, with cleaning, caring, and shining products, maintaining your shoes’ new and fresh look will be an easy feat.
data.mainEntity_5_name: Which footwear can be worn in all seasons?
data.mainEntity_5_acceptedAnswer_text: While every season has its set of suitable footwear, ballerinas, sneakers, boots and sandals in waterproof material are the best option to get you through all seasons.

data.text_content:
Metro Shoes - Buy Footwear Online in India
Established in the year of freedom, 1947, Metro Shoes opened up as a footwear store in Colaba, Mumbai and over seven decades, the brand has become a common name in Indian households. Recognised for their skilled craftsmanship, unmatched quality and style quotient, they have the best shoes catering to the diverse tastes of Indian men, women and kids. Metro Shoes is the country's top footwear brand and is proud of its network of shoe stores in over 100+ cities and an online store providing exclusive fashion footwear and accessories.
More About Metro Shoes
The Metro Shoes Online Range
Metro is dedicated to designing stylish shoes and accessories that are fashionable and comfortable for customers. Crafted to perfection, Metro's branded shoes and accessories never fail to amaze. Take a look through our store of online shoes and accessories to bring home a box of joy!
Men's Shoes
There are many collections of men's casual shoes as well as formal, ethnic, sports and party wear styles. These feature moccasins, loafers, sandals and floaters, slippers and flip flops, sneakers, boots and Kolhapuri chappals available in a range of sizes.
Women's Shoes
The assortment of women's footwear features different styles of formal, casual, party, wedding, ethnic and sports shoes. In addition, this massive selection offers sandals, ballerinas, pumps, loafers, peep toes, sneakers, boots, and ethnic shoes with different types of heels.
Kids' Shoes
The kids' collection features formal, casual and school shoes. For boys, we offer sandals, moccasins, loafers, derby and sneakers. Our shoes for girls include sandals, slippers, sneakers and ballerinas.
Spot Your Pair of Metro Shoes
Pick your pair of Metro Shoes to ace the style game. Here's how!
1. Casual Wear
Men: Trendy sneakers go well with jeans and T-shirts to style and comfort their everyday fashion.
Women: Pretty flats and ballerinas offer comfort and versatility that look great with ethnic and western casual wear.
2. Formal Wear
Men: Formal shoes in black, brown and other basic colours go well with shirts, trousers and blazers.
Women: Flat sandals as well as heels like block, wedge and kitten heels, can be paired with ethnic and western workwear.
3. Party & Festive Wear
Men: Metro Shoes' classy formal shoes or loafers pair well with western and ethnic wear for parties and Indian festive or wedding celebrations.
Women: Select from pumps, stilettos, peep toes and some Indian style footwear for parties depending on your outfits. The options for each style are plenty!
4. Boys
Boys can wear a pair of colourful sneakers with their trackpants and T-shirts or slip into casual open toe sandals to pair with shorts and a shirt. For formal events, boys can wear moccasins with a suit or even ethnic attire.
5. Girls
Girls can wear pretty open-toe sandals in eye-catching colours with their jeans and top or even opt for flat ballerina shoes to go with a floral dress. For formal occasions, Metro Shoes offers elegant platform sandals that are safe for girls to wear with western dresses and ethnic wear alike.
Buy Shoes Online and Step Out in Style
Metro shoes aim to bring its customers the choicest pair of exclusive fashionable shoes. You will love our value-for-money shoe prices that will make Metro shoes your go-to for stylish footwear for all occasions.
Shoes FAQs
1. What are the most stylish and currently trending shoes online?
For every occasion, stylish designer shoes work as a fashion statement. Vibrant coloured sneakers and modern flats for casuals and glittery ethnic Kolhapuri chappals and heels for parties are trending. Check out our extensive range to pick the perfect pair for you!
2. What are some tips to buy a shoe online?
Take a good look through the online shoe stores' collections for options and check their size chart. Consider checking specifications on the sole, heel, material, fastening type and other aspects before buying expensive shoes.
3. Where can I shop for the best shoes online?
Metro's online shoe stores offer thousands of designs and styles of shoes for various occasions, be it casual wear, parties and festivals, sports, or formal workwear to fulfil your fashion needs.
4. How to measure shoe size?
Place your foot on an A4 paper and vertically hold your pen to make a dot at the end of your heel and longest toe, then trace the outline of your foot. Measure the distance between both points with a ruler to note the centimetres. Do the same for your other foot and check out the brand's size chart to find your perfect size.
5. Can all types of shoes be washed?
Rubber and silicon material shoes can be washed while some others cannot be washed. However, with cleaning, caring, and shining products, maintaining your shoes' new and fresh look will be an easy feat.
6. Which footwear can be worn in all seasons?
While every season has its set of suitable footwear, ballerinas, sneakers, boots and sandals in waterproof material are the best option to get you through all seasons.
